name: noted
description: A Notion-Style Online Notebook, Instructions in README

paragraphs: Noted is a Notion-style online editor that allows users to create, edit, and organize rich content pages. It's powered by Supabase as the backend (for auth, storage, and database), and built with React.js, TypeScript, and Vite on the frontend, deployed on Netlify. Users can sign in passwordlessly, edit blocks, reorder content via drag-and-drop, and customize pages with emojis, cover images, and resizable images w/ captions. The app includes comprehensive unit and integration testing with over 95% line coverage using Vitest and React Testing Library
